metadata.description: Agent skills bundle for AI coding tools

plugins.name: leverj
plugins.description: Leverj agent skills bundle. Includes: sprint (scrum/kanban workflow on GitHub Projects v2 — issues are requirements, Project fields are state, ADRs in .dev/decisions/); triage (end-to-end triage & fix loop over an epic's sub-issues or a GitHub Projects v2 board — auto-closes dup/wontfix, bundles trivial dep bumps into PRs); security-scan (drives the leverj/security-scan Docker image for deterministic scanning; config repo-local at <repo>/.security-scan/config.yaml); security-scan-llm (drives the host security-scan-llm CLI for Codex+Claude+Gemma SAST with lane-agnostic cross-validation; config repo-local at <repo>/.security-scan/config-llm.yaml). Both substrates file into the same GitHub Projects v2 board with byte-identical fingerprints.
